2.t: By the Scripture that maketh plain

3.t: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -

4.t: Whereon every wise command is made clear

5.t: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -

6.t: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,

7.t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.

8.t: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.

9.t: Nay, but they play in doubt.

10.t: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

11.t: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

12.t: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.

13.t: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,

14.t: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?

15.t: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).

16.t: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

17.t: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,

18.t: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.

19.t: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.

20.t: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.

21.t: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.

22.t: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.

23.t: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,

24.t: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.

25.t: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

26.t: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

27.t: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

28.t: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;

29.t: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

30.t: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;

31.t: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

32.t: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.

33.t: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.

35.t: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

36.t: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!

37.t: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.

38.t: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.

39.t: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.

40.t: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,

41.t: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,

42.t: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

45.t: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

46.t: As the seething of boiling water.

47.t: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,

48.t: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.

49.t: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!

50.t: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.

51.t: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.

53.t: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.

54.t: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

55.t: They call therein for every fruit in safety.

56.t: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,

57.t: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

58.t: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.

59.t: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
